descripcion: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.9, GET /api/permissions/search-principals passes the q parameter to JavaScript RegExp construction and MongoDB regex queries in packages/data-schemas/src/methods/userGroup.ts findGroupsByNamePattern and searchPrincipals without escaping metacharacters. An authenticated user with people-picker permission can submit a catastrophic-backtracking pattern that blocks the Node.js event loop and makes the service unresponsive to concurrent users; invalid patterns can also produce server errors. LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, POST /api/messages/:conversationId authorizes req.params.conversationId in api/server/middleware/validateMessageReq.js but persists attacker-controlled req.body.conversationId through api/server/routes/messages.js. An authenticated attacker can use an owned conversation in the URL while naming a victim conversation in the body, causing an attacker-controlled message to be stored in the victim conversation. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6. 20/11/2026 20/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

WPC Smart Messages for WooCommerce plugin before 4.3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor or Author privileges to disclose arbitrary post meta and private product data by supplying attacker-controlled id and key attributes to the [wpcsm_product_field] and [wpcsm_product_data] shortcodes without any capability or protected-meta checks.
